tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Battery bank for 2X20kVA UPS System of Ash Handling Plant at 2X800 MW YTPS
tenderSchedule.description: a .Supply, Erection and Commissioning of 1 Nos. battery bank (110 Nos. Batteries) of 2V, 250Ah Exide, Model YKP-21 (Plante) Battery for AHP UPS system. b. Dismantling and transportation of released batteries (Make Exide, Model No. YKP-21 (Plante)) along with accessories to bidders location. c. Carrying out initial charging / discharging of batteries and service personnel should be available till the batteries are taken in line with the system. d. To make necessary load arrangements for carrying out discharge test of batteries. e. Providing suitable stand for mounting batteries, cables, accessories and other consumables like bolts, nuts, connectors (consumables 10 percent extra should be supplied) etc. f. Tools & Tackles required for completion of work.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer I1 Office YTPS Raichur

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The intending bidder shall meet the following Pre-Qualification Requirements (PQR) and submit the relevant documentary evidence in support thereof. Fulfillment of these requirements is a mandatory pre-requisite for opening of Part-II (Price Bid).

Manufacturers Authorization: The bidder shall be an authorized dealer of Exide batteries or shall possess a valid Manufacturers Authorization Letter issued by Exide, specifically authorizing the bidder to participate in the subject tender for Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Battery Bank for 2 X 20 kVA UPS System of Ash Handling Plant at 2 X 800 MW YTPS. The bidder shall submit a copy of the valid Manufacturers Authorization Certificate/ Authorization Letter as documentary evidence along with the bid.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The bidder shall have successfully executed works involving Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Battery Banks of similar rating (2V, 250 AH, Model: YKP-21) or higher rating in Thermal Power Plants of 210 MW capacity and above, or in Government Organizations / Public Sector Undertakings such as BHEL, NTPC or State GENCOs, with a cumulative executed order value of not less than Rs. 14.50 Lakhs. As documentary evidence, the bidder shall submit copies of relevant Work Orders / Job Orders / Purchase Orders (POs). The stipulated cumulative order value may be established through a single work order or a maximum of two work orders, executed during any two of the preceding five years reckoned from the date of notification of the tender.

The bidder shall have achieved an average annual turnover of not less than Rs.29.00 Lakhs in any two financial years out of the preceding five financial years reckoned from the date of notification of the tender. As documentary evidence, the bidder shall submit copies of the relevant Profit and Loss Statements along with a Turnover Certificate duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA).
